Israeli strikes reported in Gaza and Syria, causing casualties

Reports indicate Israeli military actions have resulted in casualties in both Gaza and Syria. In Gaza, strikes have killed civilians, including children, amidst ongoing offensives. Simultaneously, Israel has conducted incursions and bombardments in southern Syria, drawing condemnation from Turkey and Syria itself for alleged violations of international law and impact on civilians.
